Great. It returns two precursors: "BrBr" (dibromomethane? Actually BrBr is Br-Br) and "O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2" (same as original but without Br? Actually original had Br substituent; now product maybe removed). Anyway.

Now next template 1914399. Apply to one of these, maybe "BrBr". Let's get template 1914399.
<thought>Retrieve template 1914399.</thought>
<action>get_template</action>
<action_input>{"template_id": "1914399"}</action_input>


Now apply to "BrBr".
<thought>Apply template 1914399 to BrBr.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "BrBr", "template_id": "1914399"}</action_input>


Wait for result.


We need result.
If empty, we can apply to other precursor. Let's wait.
